_note: ENV-04 (E14): the crushing toy press. The head rests up, telegraphs (it shakes and its light comes on, the page plays ENV-press-windup), slams, holds, then rises, all on a timer. The cycle is in seconds: up (the rest) 2.0, telegraph 0.7, slam 0.12, down 0.5, rise 1.0, one whole press 4.32 s. At the end of the slam the footprint is tested: the pad's box (reach keeps it matched to the pad, 0 means the pad exactly; past the pad both player and Foamer are denied) up to the head's lowest point. The player inside takes damage through its own health path (the difficulty rides along; the grace a recent hit left does not stop it, and the raised shield does not block it), a Foamer inside pops the way a catastrophic hit pops, and the page plays ENV-press-slam. damage is the player health the crush takes: 100 is the full bar, so at Normal with no armour (damageTaken 1) one slam downs; on Story (damageTaken 0.5) the same slam is 50. Geometry is in metres: head thickness 0.5, a 2 cm air gap above the pad at the bottom, the pad 6 cm thick, the posts 0.3 m wide, the shake 3 cm at 12 Hz. [Paul] the look: the lime and purple are a placeholder that stays away from orange (weak spot), pink (parryable), blue and yellow (the player's darts); the pad's purple is a colour no floor uses (the floors are greybox).
